cnbc.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
cnbc.desc: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

cnbc.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility
cnbc.desc: The Anthropic IPO is "what the markets need." However, analysts say its shares will be volatile in the coming weeks.

cnbc.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
cnbc.desc: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

cnbc.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
cnbc.desc: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

cnbc.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
cnbc.desc: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

cnbc.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
cnbc.desc: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

cnbc.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
cnbc.desc: SoftBank shares plunged over 16% on Friday as Japanese and South Korean technology stocks fell sharply.

cnbc.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
cnbc.desc: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

cnbc.title: Jensen Huang's — and Nvidia's — legal exposure balloons
cnbc.desc: "It's not going to get any better for Jensen Huang; it's going to get far worse," said Salvatore Graziano, a New York securities litigation attorney.

cnbc.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
cnbc.desc: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

cnbc.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
cnbc.desc: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

cnbc.title: One of the world's most contested seas is proving too much for Asia's leaders to resolve
cnbc.desc: The ASEAN summit in the Philippines failed to conclude the Code of Conduct for the South China Sea despite Manila pledging it would happen this year.

cnbc.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
cnbc.desc: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

cnbc.title: Trump bought Nvidia, Palantir, SpaceX in September as federal deals, White House ties grew
cnbc.desc: President Trump disclosed purchases of Nvidia stock, SpaceX debt and Tesla shares in September, alongside millions of dollars in other investments.

cnbc.title: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes
cnbc.desc: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.
